description: 10 high-quality continuous stations across 7 key urban regions selected for empirical validation; remaining 93 stations lack continuous concurrent ERA5/OpenAQ co-location in the pilot window.
847 six-hourly synoptic slices executed with concurrent OpenAQ PM2.5 and ERA5 U10/V10; 593 unmonitored slices recorded with zero imputation.
199 station-days satisfy the statutory CPCB criterion of >=16 valid hourly samples (>=66.7% daily capture); 27 station-days excluded from regulatory AQI calculation.
Only PM2.5 is modeled and observed. Multi-pollutant regulatory NAQI (which requires PM10, NO2, SO2, CO, O3) is approximated via the official CPCB PM2.5 sub-index.
Dispersion model uses horizontal 10m wind fields (ERA5 U10/V10) on a 0.25 deg grid. Assumes vertically well-mixed boundary layer; vertical wind shear and complex terrain flow are unrepresented.
Aerosol particles treated as passive conservative tracers. Dry deposition, wet scavenging by precipitation, and secondary aerosol chemistry are not parameterized.
Modeled influence is calculated strictly on time-aligned synoptic events (Phase 11). Multiplication of instantaneous source observations by multi-year climatological matrices is prohibited.
